name: png2amiga
description: PNG/JPEG to Commodore Amiga graphics converter — OCS/AGA bitplane, HAM6/HAM8, EHB, copper palettes, 64 dithering modes and much more

paragraphs: Try it in your browser at png2amiga.app — live preview via WebAssembly, server-side compile to Amiga executables.
Aimed at retro-platform asset pipelines (Amiga / Atari / IBM PC demoscene, hobby AmigaOS games, MS-DOS coding). All color operations use OKLab perceptual color space. Sister project to png2c64.
features: Amiga modes: Lores / Hires (+ interlace), HAM6 (OCS) + HAM8 (AGA) with hires and/or interlace variants, EHB. 1–8 bitplanes within chipset limits. Optional sliced palette (per-line copper swaps — the same technique…

Atari modes: STF Low/Medium/Hi, STE Low/Medium/Hi (9-bit palette on STF, 12-bit on STE; ST-Hi is hardware-locked monochrome). Degas Elite .PI1/.PI2/.PI3 output. Spectrum 512/4096 raster modes add .spu, .cpp, and…
ZX Spectrum: 256×192, two colors per 8×8 cell with shared BRIGHT; native .scr export.

IBM PC modes: CGA 320×200 / 640×200 / composite (NTSC artifact colors), CGA text-mode glyph matching at 80x{200,100,50,25} and 40x{200,100} cell grids, EGA 320×200 / 640×200 / 640×350 (16 of the 64-color IrgbIRGB…

Commodore 64: VIC-II hires (320×200, 2 colors per 8×8 cell), multicolor (160×200, 4 per 4×8), FLI / AFLI (per-row screen-RAM swaps for more colors per cell), PETSCII (40×25 text-mode glyph matching against the C64…
